defs.def: the process or result of dividing into separate parts; the process or result of dividing sth or sharing it out 分开；分隔；分配；（分出来的）部分

ex.s: Instead, she recommends applying a well-known concept among nutrition experts called the “Division of Responsibility,” where parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods to their kids at fixed times, and the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume — even if that means occasionally eating more cookies than carrots.
ex.t: 争论宇宙是一座时钟、一组粒子还是计算的产物是没有意义的。

ex.s: What should kids do according to the “Division of Responsibility”?
ex.t: 在加拿大北部严酷的生存环境下，因纽特人的实用主义道德观是非常合理的。

defs.def: the process of dividing one number by another 除（法）

ex.s: Now it was up to the living to remove not only the divisions between North and South, but the boundaries between black and white, and work step by step towards the equality of humankind.
ex.t: 现在轮到活着的人不仅消除南北之间的隔阂，还要消除黑人与白人之间的界限，一步步迈向人类的平等。

ex.s: He saw no division between art, invention, and science—they were all a part of his wonderful new world of discovery.
ex.t: 他认为艺术、发明和科学之间没有界限——它们都是他奇妙的新发现世界的一部分。

ex.s: The sun and moon looked as if they were being thrown across the sky, but soon there was division between night and day.
ex.t: 太阳和月亮看起来像是在天空中被抛来抛去，但很快昼夜之间就出现了分界。

ex.s: There are divisions among historians over when exactly the construction of the twin temples started, but no one can deny the fact that they were constructed in the 13th century BCE.
ex.t: 历史学家们对于这两座双子神庙具体是何时开始建造的存在分歧，但没有人能否认它们是在公元前13世纪建造的这一事实。

defs.def: a disagreement or difference in opinion, way of life, etc., especially between members of a society or an organization 分歧；不和；差异
a large and important unit or section of an organization （机构的）部门
(in Britain) one of the group of teams that a sport competition is divided into, especially in football (soccer) （英国体育运动，尤指足球比赛的）级
a unit of an army, consisting of several brigades or regiments 师
a line that divides sth 分界线
the separation of members of the British parliament into groups to vote for or against sth （英国议会的）分组表决

ex.s: The foundation of Australia First impressions Reflections on multiculturalism Preparing to travel Political divisions Aborigines and the didgeridoo 5 Work in groups.
ex.t: 澳大利亚的基础 第一印象 对多元文化主义的反思 准备旅行 政治区划 土著人和迪吉里杜管 5 小组合作。
